values.note: 2026 RV-only sites: no hookup $45, water & electric $55, full-hookup back-in $60, full-hookup pull-through $65; a $7/day vehicle fee is collected with every reservation. Only one of the 11 no-hookup RV sites takes 25 ft (the rest 15-20 ft), so a 23-ft rig realistically pays $55-65. ReserveAmerica processing fee $8.75 per site per trip. Dump $10, propane $3.49/gal, firewood $7.

fees.source: https://evrpd.com/campgrounds/ ('2026 Camping Rates ... RV ONLY No Hookup Site $45 | Water & Electric Site $55 | Mary's Lake Full Hookup Back-in Site $60 | Mary's Lake Full Hookup Pull-thru Site $65 | Vehicle fee $7'; 'The Reserve America reservation processing fee is $8.75 per site, per camping trip'; 'A $7.00 per day vehicle fee will be collected at the time of the reservation') + ReserveAmerica site list (RV ONLY - NO HOOKUPS: one site 25 ft, nine 20 ft, one 15 ft), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: https://evrpd.com/campground-faq/ ('“Big Rig” full hookup campsites with water, electric, and sewer are available at the Estes Park Campground at Mary’s Lake with 30/50 amp service') + ReserveAmerica per-site Electricity Hookup 50 on all full-hookup sites, read 2026-10-28

values.note: EVRPD says 128 sites; ReserveAmerica's overview says 120 and its catalog lists 117: 82 RV-only (24 full-hookup back-in, 24-32 ft; 23 full-hookup pull-through, 35-56 ft; 24 water & electric, sixteen 25 ft and eight 20 ft; 11 no-hookup, one 25 ft and ten 15-20 ft) and 35 tent-only. About 64 RV sites take a 23-ft rig. Lengths are strictly enforced (measured hitch to bumper).

sites.source: https://evrpd.com/marys-lake/ ('has 128 sites suitable for everyone from tenters to RVers with big rigs') + https://evrpd.com/campground-faq/ ('full hookup sites for rigs up to 43’ in length'; 'the maximum allowable length is listed on the site description on ReserveAmerica') + ReserveAmerica campsites list (ALL 117; per-site Max Vehicle Length / Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Coin-op hot showers (quarters), heated swimming pool, propane filling, playground; picnic table, fire ring and bear locker at every site. No Wi-Fi; cell coverage good.

facilities.source: https://evrpd.com/marys-lake/ ('access to drinking water, flush toilets, coin-op hot showers, dump station, propane filling station, firewood and ice sales, a heated swimming pool, a fully stocked camp store, laundry facilities, and a playground') + https://evrpd.com/campground-faq/ ('We are not able to provide Wi-Fi due to limited bandwidth'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: EVRPD: mid-May to late September; ReserveAmerica gives the 2026 season as May 22 - September 26.

season.source: https://evrpd.com/marys-lake/ ('This campground is open from mid-May to late-September') + https://www.reserveamerica.com/explore/estes-park-campground-at-marys-lake/ESTS/300100/overview ('SEASON DATES MAY 22 - SEPTEMBER 26, 2026'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: ReserveAmerica online or (800) 964-7806, up to 180 days ahead and up to the arrival date. Two nights on weekends; three on Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day; none Monday-Thursday. Any unreserved site is first-come at the office (no walk-ins after the store closes at 8 pm). 14 days in 28; no monthly stays. Check-in 2 pm, out 11 am.

booking.source: https://evrpd.com/campgrounds/ Reservation Guidelines ('No minimum stays on Mondays – Thursdays unless a holiday is involved. Two-night minimum stay is required on all weekends ... Three-night minimum stay is required on the holidays of Memorial Day, Independence Day, and Labor Day. Reservations are accepted up to and including the arrival date. The farthest out you can make a reservation is 180 days') + https://evrpd.com/campground-faq/ ('If a site does not have a reservation, it is available as a “first-come first-served” site') + ReserveAmerica overview ('Maximum stay is 14 days in a 28 day period. No extended stays or monthly rentals'), read 2026-10-28

note: Estes Valley Recreation and Park District campground at 8,050 ft on the south edge of Estes Park, a few miles from Rocky Mountain NP's south entrance; mostly open and sunny, view to the Twin Sisters. Mary's Lake is across Mary's Lake Road (shore fishing only - no boating or swimming). --Claude
summary: EVRPD pages + ReserveAmerica catalog: confirmed 2026 rates $45-65 (+$7/day vehicle fee, $8.75 RA fee), 50-amp full hookups, showers/laundry/store/dump, reservable on ReserveAmerica. Added max length 56 ft and pull-throughs, season May 22 - Sept 26 (2026), 180-day window, weekend/holiday minimums, 14-night max, no Wi-Fi. ~64 of 82 RV-only sites take a 23-ft rig. Pin on the RV loops (57 m from their centroid). Note trimmed of the restated sites/hookups/amenities/season.
flags: Base rate: the $45 no-hookup RV class has only one site long enough (25 ft; the other ten are 15-20 ft), so $45 is the true floor but most 23-ft bookings will be $55 (water & electric, 25-ft sites) or more. Plus a mandatory $7/day vehicle fee. Local government: no price gate.
Phone missing: the EVRPD site gives the campground as 970-577-1026 (site footer) and 970-577-1024 (campgrounds page); camp@evrpd.com. Reservations (800) 964-7806.
Site count conflict: EVRPD page 128, ReserveAmerica overview 120, ReserveAmerica catalog 117 (82 RV-only, 35 tent-only). Count left at 128 (the operator's figure).

Waterfront (stored not waterfront): Mary's Lake is across Mary's Lake Road from the campground; the nearest site points sit ~50-80 m from the reservoir's bare drawdown apron with the road between, so not waterfront stands. The operator says the Twin Sisters 'frames your view as you look over Mary's Lake' and the front loop is open ground facing the lake - a lakeview re-audit lead; not changed.
Operator note: the FAQ says 'the campgrounds are on Federal property' (Mary's Lake is a Bureau of Reclamation reservoir); EVRPD operates and sets the rates, so ownership local stands.

Wording: the ReserveAmerica campsite page showed 'Current Status - Closed until further notice' on 2026-10-28, which reads as the off-season state (season ended Sept 26; EVRPD says 'We’re open for the 2026 season!'); no closure banner on EVRPD.
